summary: ePlus inc. filed an 8-K reporting second-quarter and first-half fiscal 2027 results for the periods ended September 30, 2026, via press release (Exhibit 99.1, Item 2.02), alongside an Item 5.02 disclosure that General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer Erica Stoecker will retire. Stoecker serves through November 27, 2026, then becomes Special Counsel on a reduced 30-hour schedule until February 5, 2027, and 20 hours thereafter, with corresponding pay reductions, until retirement on or about June 30, 2027. Amanda Dupree, Deputy General Counsel since 2017, succeeds her as Chief Legal Officer and Chief Compliance Officer effective the Transition Date. This is a planned, orderly succession rather than an abrupt departure, and no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated.
